environment.edit_implementation_note: 'direct' = ((topK(a_edited) - topK(a)) @ w_dec) * std ; 'dor' = decode(a_edited, mu, std) - decode(a, mu, std). Algebraically identical; 'direct' avoids the fp32 cancellation.

engineering_sample.source: DeepLoc2/sae_pilot/sae_pilot_sample.tsv (seed 42, label x length-quartile stratified, built by esm2_common/sae_sample.py)
engineering_sample.selection_rule: filter original seq_len <= 1022 and split_role == development_P1_4, sort by accession ascending, take first 8
engineering_sample.note: The 64-protein source sample is label-stratified by construction, so these 8 inherit that stratification. The selection applied here within it uses only accession order and sequence length.
engineering_sample.designation: ENGINEERING-ONLY. These accessions are reserved from future confirmatory intervention evaluation.

metric_vocabulary.full_vocab_note: softmax over all 33 ESM-2 tokens, including <cls> <pad> <eos> <unk> X B U Z O . - <null_1> <mask>
metric_vocabulary.aa20_note: logits restricted to the 20 standard amino acids and re-softmaxed; this is the "amino-acid prediction" distribution used for headline KL

sae_reference_agreement.pilot_regression_note: The sae_pilot_report.json aggregates (0.1109 / 0.5178) were computed over 64 unmasked proteins with different pooling. They are not required to match this 8-protein masked sample and are not used as a pass criterion.

repeat_run_variation.note: Established before any intervention. Downstream differences are judged against this floor, not against zero.

impl_comparison.criterion_note: Strict per-condition dominance was tested first and FAILED (62/64). It was replaced because it asserted an ordering that is arbitrary at the rounding floor, not because the direct form underperformed. This is a RELAXATION of numerical acceptance on the per-condition axis, paired with a strict aggregate criterion.

feature_rule_coverage.note: The strongest-active rule concentrates on a near-always-on high-magnitude latent, so the median-rank rule was added to exercise typical features too.
